$comment: The accelerator is invented (the Batchery) and so is its partner, Paxton Longform: a caricature of the essay-writing accelerator partner, not of any one real person. Coordinates: DataSF EAS addresses (3mea-di5p) and street centerlines (3psu-pn9h), fetched 2026-10-20.
title: The Partner Meeting
summary: Your partner meeting at the Batchery moved up to 10:00. It is 09:51 and you are in the Marina. Get to Dogpatch, survive four questions from a partner in a fleece vest, and either get funded or get told to come back with traction.

slotsworth.name: Slotsworth
slotsworth.description: Relentlessly upbeat. Has already accepted on your behalf.

paxton.name: Paxton Longform
paxton.description: Invented caricature of the essay-writing accelerator partner: fleece vest, three blog posts a day, hears every pitch as material for the next one.

steps.note: Rings when the player is at their apartment.

place.label: Your apartment (Marina, Toledo Way)
place.source: Toledo Way centerline between EAS 2-30 Toledo Way; a street, not an address

lines.speaker: slotsworth
lines.text: Hi! Slotsworth here, Paxton Longform's scheduling agent. Great news: your partner meeting moved up.

lines.speaker: slotsworth
lines.text: It's now at ten. It is nine fifty-one. I accepted on your behalf. You're welcome!

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Ten? As in nine minutes from now?

lines.speaker: slotsworth
lines.text: Paxton has a hard stop at ten fifteen to write an essay about hard stops. The Batchery, 315 Pennsylvania, Dogpatch. See you there!

target.label: The Batchery, 315 Pennsylvania Ave, Dogpatch
target.source: Interpolated between EAS 301 (37.762547, -122.393263) and 331 (37.762271, -122.393236) Pennsylvania Ave

lines.speaker: slotsworth
lines.text: Reminder: Paxton doesn't wait. Paxton writes about people who make him wait.

lines.speaker: frontDesk
lines.text: Welcome to the Batchery. Paxton is finishing a blog post. It's about patience.

lines.speaker: frontDesk
lines.text: Kombucha is on tap. It's also on the cap table.

intro.speaker: paxton
intro.text: Love the energy. I've got eleven minutes and a draft open, so let's go.

answers.text: Network effects. Every new user makes it harder to leave.
answers.reply: Ooh. I've written four essays about that. Five, after today.

answers.text: Speed. We ship faster than anyone.
answers.reply: Speed isn't a moat. It's a puddle. That's going in the blog.

answers.text: It's in the deck. Slide nine.
answers.reply: Slide nine is a photo of an actual moat. There's a swan.

answers.text: A year ago this was impossible. Next year it's a free feature. Now is the window.
answers.reply: A closing window. Investors love a closing window.

answers.text: The robotaxis finally stopped circling our office.
answers.reply: Mine still circles my office. I think it's lonely.

answers.text: Honestly? The bar was low, and so were we.
answers.reply: Candid. Too candid. Let's keep that out of the memo.

answers.text: Every company was a feature once. So was email.
answers.reply: Bold. That's an essay. Possibly a book.

answers.text: It's a feature with a waitlist.
answers.reply: A waitlist is a feature with ambition. I'll allow it.

answers.text: Yes. The big platforms will ship it next quarter.
answers.reply: Ah. Honesty. We have a portfolio company for that. It's also struggling.

answers.text: Forty thousand on the waitlist. Some of them are people.
answers.reply: Some is a number. I'll take it.

answers.text: Three customers who pay us every month. On purpose.
answers.reply: Revenue? In this economy? Weird. Interesting. Mostly weird.

answers.text: Our launch video has a million views. Mostly us.
answers.reply: Views are a vibe. Vibes aren't a metric. That's my next post.

lines.speaker: paxton
lines.text: I'm in. Don't tell anyone until I've blogged about it.

lines.speaker: slotsworth
lines.text: Congratulations! I booked your billboard on the 101. And a therapist. Both start Monday.

place.label: US-101 northbound, Potrero Hill curve
place.source: 30 m east of the midpoint of HWY 101 NORTHBOUND segment CNN 19215000; faces oncoming northbound traffic (road bearing about 345 degrees)

lines.speaker: paxton
lines.text: I love it. I'm out. Come back with traction.

lines.speaker: paxton
lines.text: I'll send you my essay on traction. It's long. Read it twice.

steps.hint: Get some traction, or a better answer to 'Isn't this just a feature?', then take the call again.

lines.speaker: slotsworth
lines.text: Paxton waited ninety seconds, then wrote a post about founders who are late. You're the hero of it.

lines.speaker: slotsworth
lines.text: I've rescheduled you for tomorrow. Same time. Earlier, probably.
